title: Sultaan e Karbala
body:
Hussain.. Hussain.. Hussain.. Hussain..
Sabeel, rizq, tabarruk, niyaz ki soorat
Hussain baat raha hai khuda ke bando ko
Hussain...
Hussain hussain Hussain
Ya habibi, Ya Hussain..(2)
Roohi lakal fida
<<MINI>>
Hussain! Hussain!
Sultan e Karbala
Hussain! Hussain!
Bunyaad e la ilaah
<<DIVIDER>>
Eyes will cry for you, time will pass and you remain
In the heart of voice keeps calling at O Hussain
Al hamd teri shaan mein aayi hai ya Hussain
kabze mein tere saari khudayi hai ya Hussain
<<MINI>>
Aye jaan e Mustafa, Farzand e Fatima
<<DIVIDER>>
subhe dahum se hai awaaz e karbala
maqrooz hai tera, har banda e khuda
<<MINI>>
Hussain! Hussain!
Sultan e Karbala
Hussain! Hussain!
Bunyaad e la ilaah
<<DIVIDER>>
Tune zamee'n kharidi jo akbar ke naam par
jageer hai wo teri shehenshah e behrobar
<<MINI>>
Aye jaan e Mustafa, Farzand e Fatima
<<DIVIDER>>
ek samt tera darr, ek samt bawafa
tune bana diye, do qible ek jagah
<<MINI>>
Hussain! Hussain!
Sultan e Karbala
Hussain! Hussain!
Bunyaad e la ilaah
<<DIVIDER>>
Har saal arba'een pe dekha hai ye samaa
aake karodo log jhukate hai sar yaha'n
<<MINI>>
Aye jaan e Mustafa, Farzand e Fatima
<<DIVIDER>>
sab pursa daar hai, hum aur ambiyaa
aate hai sab yaha'n dete hue sadaa
<<MINI>>
Hussain! Hussain!
Sultan e Karbala
Hussain! Hussain!
Bunyaad e la ilaah
<<DIVIDER>>
Teri sakhawato ki hai ye bhi to ek daleel
khud pyaasa qatl hoke hume baksh di sabeel
<<MINI>>
Aye jaan e Mustafa, Farzand e Fatima
<<DIVIDER>>
pyaasa nahi yaha'n, za'er koi tera
kya hai ye mojiza?, ya hai karam tera?
<<MINI>>
Hussain! Hussain!
Sultan e Karbala
Hussain! Hussain!
Bunyaad e la ilaah
<<DIVIDER>>
Aye khoon e Kibriya, dar dasht e karbala
tu fat-ha paa gaya, jab hurr ne keh diya
<<MINI>>
Hussain! Hussain!
Sultan e Karbala
Hussain! Hussain!
Bunyaad e la ilaah
<<DIVIDER>>
Jiski rago mein aatish e badr o Hunain hai
tere siwa wo kaun shahe mashreqayn hai
<<MINI>>
Aye jaan e Mustafa, Farzand e Fatima
<<DIVIDER>>
Ashoor dekh kar, sabit ye hogaya
dar asl hai tuhi, bunyaad e la ilaah
<<MINI>>
Hussain! Hussain!
Sultan e Karbala
Hussain! Hussain!
Bunyaad e la ilaah
<<DIVIDER>>
Aye shahe karbobala, ho tera matam sadaa
bus yehi armaan hai, Mazhar o Irfan ka
<<MINI>>
As salam aye ghareeb ul watan as salam..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Rukhsar jo lahu mein huwe tar, unhe salam
jo bibiya thi ban mein khule sar, unhe salam
naizo pe jo sajaye gaye sar, unhe salam
barsaye jinpe logo ne patthar, unhe salam
<<MINI>>
As salam aye ghareeb ul watan as salam..(3)
